record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732> the servant<WH05650> of the LORD<WH03068>.<Fo><Fo> The transgression<WH06588> of the wicked<WH07563> saith<WH05002><WTH8803> within<WH07130> my heart<WH03820>, <FI>that there is<Fi> no fear<WH06343> of God<WH0430> before his eyes<WH05869>.

For he flattereth<WH02505><WTH8689> himself in his own eyes<WH05869>, until his iniquity<WH05771> be found<WH04672><WTH8800> to be hateful<WH08130><WTH8800>. <RF>until...: Heb. to find his iniquity to hate<Rf>
The words<WH01697> of his mouth<WH06310> <FI>are<Fi> iniquity<WH0205> and deceit<WH04820>: he hath left off<WH02308><WTH8804> to be wise<WH07919><WTH8687>, <FI>and<Fi> to do good<WH03190><WTH8687>.

He deviseth<WH02803><WTH8799> mischief<WH0205> upon his bed<WH04904>; he setteth<WH03320><WTH8691> himself in a way<WH01870> <FI>that is<Fi> not good<WH02896>; he abhorreth<WH03988><WTH8799> not evil<WH07451>. <RF>mischief: or, vanity<Rf><CM>
Thy mercy<WH02617>, O LORD<WH03068>, <FI>is<Fi> in the heavens<WH08064>; <FI>and<Fi> thy faithfulness<WH0530> <FI>reacheth<Fi> unto the clouds<WH07834>.

Thy righteousness<WH06666> <FI>is<Fi> like the great<WH0410> mountains<WH02042>; thy judgments<WH04941> <FI>are<Fi> a great<WH07227> deep<WH08415>: O LORD<WH03068>, thou preservest<WH03467><WTH8686> man<WH0120> and beast<WH0929>. <RF>the...: Heb. the mountains of God<Rf>

How excellent<WH03368> <FI>is<Fi> thy lovingkindness<WH02617>, O God<WH0430>! therefore the children<WH01121> of men<WH0120> put their trust<WH02620><WTH8799> under the shadow<WH06738> of thy wings<WH03671>. <RF>excellent: Heb. precious<Rf>

They shall be abundantly satisfied<WH07301><WTH8799> with the fatness<WH01880> of thy house<WH01004>; and thou shalt make them drink<WH08248><WTH8686> of the river<WH05158> of thy pleasures<WH05730>. <RF>abundantly...: Heb. watered<Rf>
For with thee <FI>is<Fi> the fountain<WH04726> of life<WH02416>: in thy light<WH0216> shall we see<WH07200><WTH8799> light<WH0216>.

O continue<WH04900><WTH8798> thy lovingkindness<WH02617> unto them that know<WH03045><WTH8802> thee; and thy righteousness<WH06666> to the upright<WH03477> in heart<WH03820>. <RF>continue: Heb. draw out at length<Rf>
Let not the foot<WH07272> of pride<WH01346> come<WH0935><WTH8799> against me, and let not the hand<WH03027> of the wicked<WH07563> remove<WH05110><WTH8686> me.
There are the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205> fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>: they are cast down<WH01760><WTH8795>, and shall not be able<WH03201><WTH8804> to rise<WH06965><WTH8800>.<CM>
